An intricate sculptural ecosystem of fine translucent membranes, branching leaf-vein structures and suspended seedlike forms, like a macro photograph of a living architecture made of frosted glass and ink. Large beautifully controlled organic structure in the right two thirds, left third deep near-black negative space for later editorial typography. Rich material detail, strong sophisticated silhouette, no generic brain, no DNA double helix cliche. This is explicitly a visual metaphor, not an actual microscope image or scientific diagram. No letters, words, numbers, labels, branding, logos, watermark, panels or mockups. Finish as the actual full-bleed background artwork, not a brandboard.
